rationale: The #295 widened scope's route-component chunks: the 9 loops/settings/session page chunks the admin directive puts in the product (Loops pages incl. memories + limits, the loops settings-chrome pages, the agent-session page). One hash variant per component: the raw 1.32.4 tree ships each route chunk once per hash; where two variants exist (e.g. LoopsManagementPage) the one referenced from routes.json's mounting chunks is used. Monsters = the two multi-MB shared chunks every Linear page imports; #295 R-FACADE treats them as demanded-export facades, never as reimplementation targets.
